question: What will be NVIDIA's forward guidance in its Q3 FY2027 earnings release? (Gross margin (GAAP))

calls.reasoning: On the Aug 26, 2026 Q2 FY27 call, NVIDIA management explicitly said gross margin would bottom in Q4 FY27 in the 71-72% range due to extreme memory (HBM) pricing, before 72-73% in FY28. NVIDIA guides 'X% ±50bp', typically with X at .0/.5, so 71.5 is the modal midpoint, with 71.0 and 72.0 as alternates; a small GAAP-below-non-GAAP gap could give 71.3-71.4. Memory prices rising further is a downside risk; price hikes/mix an upside risk. Polymarket only covers Q3 non-GAAP actual GM (73-75% at 0.88), a different quarter/metric — evidence that Q3 is tracking the 74% guide, not an anchor. No market found for the Q4 GAAP guide midpoint.
calls.dossier:
- Q2 FY27 press release (Aug 26, 2026, nvidianews): Q3 FY27 outlook GAAP & non-GAAP GM 74.0% ±50bp; Q2 FY27 GAAP GM 75.0%, Q1 FY27 74.9%. Revenue guide $108.0B ±2%.
- Q2 FY27 earnings call (Aug 26, 2026; Yahoo Finance call highlights, fnnews Aug 27, PrimeXBT/investinglive preview): management said gross margin expected to bottom in Q4 FY27 in the 71% to 72% range due to extreme memory pricing; expected to settle at 72-73% in FY28.
- CFO Kress (Aug 2026, Fool/KuCoin coverage): memory price increases already surpassed prior expectations and would continue rising into next year; purchase commitments rose from $119B (Q1) to $279B (Q2), mostly memory, for FY27-FY29.
- NVIDIA's guidance format: 'GAAP and non-GAAP gross margins expected to be X%, plus or minus 50 basis points', X typically at .0 or .5; recent quarters GAAP = non-GAAP guide, historically GAAP sometimes 0.1-0.3pt below non-GAAP.
- Q3 FY27 quarter ended ~Oct 25, 2026; results Nov 17, 2026 after close.
- Nov 2026 news: NVDA stock fell ~10% in one day around Nov 10 (Fool); Wells Fargo lowered PT ahead of Q3 (TipRanks) — reasons not verified.
- Status quo: guide midpoint consistent with prior 71-72% commentary.
- Resolution instrument: resolves off the GAAP gross margin midpoint in the Outlook section of Q3 FY27 press release (Q4 FY27 guide), rounded to 0.1%; not non-GAAP, not actual Q3 results.
- Event window: release on Nov 17, 2026 -> single-event; as of Nov 10, 2026 the release has not occurred.
- Searched but not found: any updated (post-August) management commentary on Q4 margin; sell-side consensus for Q4 GM guide specifically; any market pricing Q4 GAAP GM guide (Polymarket only lists Q3 non-GAAP actual GM buckets).

calls.reasoning: On the Aug 26, 2026 Q2 FY27 call, management explicitly said gross margin would bottom in Q4 FY27 at 71-72% (memory costs). NVIDIA guides 'X% ±50bp' and GAAP has matched non-GAAP recently, so a 71.5% midpoint (range 71-72) is the modal outcome. Downside: memory prices still rising, unexplained ~10% stock drop near Nov 10, and a possible small GAAP-below-non-GAAP gap. Upside: price increases or mix arriving early. Market check: Polymarket lists only Q3 actual non-GAAP GM buckets (73-75% at 0.88, <$5k volume). That is a different quarter and metric, so it is evidence only. No market found on the Q4 guide.
calls.reconciliation: All runs agree on the facts (Q3 guide 74.0% ±50bp; Aug call signal of a 71-72% Q4 bottom; no post-August revision found; no matching market). Median 71.5 is undisputed. The only dispute is tail width (90-10 of 1.0 vs 1.5), which is a judgment call. I tightened the center, because a range explicitly pre-signaled to investors is very likely to be repeated verbatim as 71.5 ±50bp, but kept a modest lower tail for memory-cost escalation and the unexplained Nov stock drop. No web access on this run.
